label: A2B_mP12_13_2g_ef-001
title: H$_{2}$S (15 GPa) Structure
comments: This structure was found by first-principles electronic structure calculations and is predicted to be the stable structure of H$_{2}$S in the range $10 - 30$~GPa, which does not agree with the experimental phase diagram (Shimizu, 1995).  The data presented here was computed at 15~GPa.
